# AI-Kubernetes-API-Generator-Demo

> Demo: natural language to Kubernetes CRD + OpenAPI 3.0 spec via OpenRouter LLM, applied to a kind cluster for testing.

AI-Kubernetes-API-Generator-Demo is maintained by Adventure Wave Labs (The lab for agentic developer tooling).
